title: Authentication Service HTTP 401 Unauthorized Errors Post-Deployment
description: All user authentication requests failing with HTTP 401 Unauthorized immediately following release v2.4.0 deployment. Database, memory, and network metrics remain 100% healthy.

evidence.content: ERROR [jwt_validator] JWT signature verification failed: invalid issuer claim 'https://auth-legacy.internal'. Expected configured issuer 'https://auth.internal'.
Deployment Release Notes v2.4.0: Updated AUTH_JWT_ISSUER environment variable to strictly match RFC7519 domain validation rules.
